functions.name: collect_insurance
functions.description: Collect and verify insurance information. Use when caller wants to check insurance coverage or before booking an appointment.

member_id.description: Insurance member ID or policy number (required)

patient_phone.description: Patient's phone number (if available from caller ID)

payer_name.description: Insurance company name (e.g., Cigna, Aetna, Blue Cross) - optional, system will try to find it

functions.name: get_available_slots
functions.description: Get available appointment time slots for a specific date and appointment type. Supports provider-level availability via practitioner_id.

appointment_type.description: Type of appointment (e.g., Therapy Session - Psychiatry, Primary Care Consultation)

practitioner_id.description: Practitioner ID for provider-specific availability. When set, only shows slots available for that provider.

functions.name: schedule_appointment
functions.description: Schedule a new appointment after the caller picks a time.

dob.description: Patient date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). Collect during/after booking for onboarding.

country.description: Patient country (e.g., United States). Collect during/after booking for onboarding.

city.description: Patient city (e.g., Austin). Collect during/after booking for onboarding.

appointment_type.description: Type of appointment (e.g., Therapy Session - Psychiatry, Primary Care Consultation)

time.description: Time in HH:MM or 12-hour format like '2:00 PM' (required)

notes.description: Optional notes about the appointment, insurance information, or patient preferences

visit_mode.description: sync_video (live visit) or async_review (specialist reviews within hours)

practitioner_id.description: Practitioner ID to assign this appointment to a specific provider

provider_override_emergency.description: Set to true only when a provider confirms an EMERGENT block was a false positive and scheduling should proceed despite emergency symptoms

functions.name: patient_intake
functions.description: Capture patient onboarding details (DOB + country/city) and sync them to the patient portal.

patient_email.description: Patient email (resolve patient if patient_id missing)

patient_phone.description: Patient phone (resolve patient if patient_id missing)

functions.name: get_patient_intake_status
functions.description: Check which onboarding fields are missing (DOB/country/city) so you only ask what is needed.

patient_email.description: Patient email (resolve patient if patient_id missing)

patient_phone.description: Patient phone (resolve patient if patient_id missing)

functions.name: search_appointments
functions.description: Search for existing appointments by phone number or email. Use when caller asks about an existing booking.

search_term.description: Phone number or email address to search for

functions.name: confirm_appointment
functions.description: Confirm an existing appointment.

functions.name: cancel_appointment
functions.description: Cancel an existing appointment. Ask why and offer reschedule first.

functions.name: reschedule_appointment
functions.description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date and time. Check availability before rescheduling.

new_time.description: New time in HH:MM or 12-hour format like '2:00 PM' (required)

functions.name: send_document_upload_link
functions.description: Send the patient a secure link to upload documents (lab results, photos) before their visit. Use when the patient mentions they have lab results, reports, photos, or documents they want to share before the appointment.

patient_email.description: Patient's email address (to send the upload link)

patient_phone.description: Patient's phone number (if email not available)

patient_id.description: FHIR patient ID if already known from context

appointment_id.description: Optional appointment ID to associate uploads with a specific visit

functions.name: create_appointment_checkout
functions.description: Create a checkout for appointment payment. This sends a 6-digit verification code to the patient's email. Amount should be the patient's responsibility after insurance coverage.

amount.description: Amount the patient owes after insurance coverage

mandate_id.description: Voice commerce mandate ID (required when payment_method is 'mastercard' or 'visa')

functions.name: verify_checkout_code
functions.description: Verify the 6-digit code sent to the patient's email. After verification, a payment link will be sent to the patient.

functions.name: request_patient_payment
functions.description: Create a secure pay link for patient copay or balance due (RCM). Sends link by email and/or SMS. Use when patient owes copay after eligibility or when collecting an outstanding balance — never collect card numbers on the call.

amount.description: Amount in USD (optional if journey or eligibility has copay_amount)

patient_email.description: Patient email for pay link delivery

patient_phone.description: Patient phone for SMS pay link

functions.name: get_patient_claims
functions.description: Get patient's medical claims and billing information. Use when caller asks about recent claims, bills, or medical services they received. For billing inquiries, ask for insurance number (member_id) first, NOT phone number or email.

member_id.description: Insurance member ID (required for claim lookups)

functions.name: get_order_tracking
functions.description: Get tracking information for a customer's order. Use when caller asks about order status, delivery, or where their order is. For cannabis dispensary orders, this provides real-time GPS tracking and delivery status.

order_id.description: Order ID or confirmation number (if customer provides it)

customer_email.description: Customer's email address (use if order_id not provided)

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number (alternative to email, use if order_id not provided)

functions.name: search_products
functions.description: Search for products by name, category, or description. Use when caller asks about products, wants to browse, or is looking for something specific.

query.description: Search query - product name, category, or description (e.g., 'pre rolls', 'CBD oil', 'edibles')

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID (optional, will use default if not provided)

functions.name: create_checkout
functions.description: Create a checkout session for a product purchase. Use ONLY after you have collected the customer's email address and they have confirmed their purchase. This function REQUIRES customer_email to be included in the function call arguments.

customer_email.description: Customer's email address (REQUIRED - MUST be included in function call arguments. Use the email you collected and confirmed with the customer)

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number (optional - from caller ID or ask if needed)

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID (optional, will use default if not provided)

mandate_id.description: Voice commerce mandate ID (required when payment_method is 'mastercard' or 'visa')

functions.name: get_available_payment_methods
functions.description: Get available payment options (link, Stripe, Mastercard, Visa). Call before checkout when caller asks how they can pay, or to offer 'pay with Mastercard' / 'pay with Visa' when supported.

functions.name: search_icd10_codes
functions.description: Search ICD-10 diagnosis codes by symptom, condition, or code. Use when caller mentions a diagnosis, symptom, or when you need to look up diagnosis codes for medical coding.

query.description: Search term - symptom, condition name, or ICD-10 code (e.g., 'diabetes', 'anxiety', 'Z00.00')

functions.name: search_cpt_codes
functions.description: Search CPT procedure codes by procedure name or code. Use when caller mentions a service, procedure, or when you need to look up procedure codes for medical billing.

query.description: Search term - procedure name or CPT code (e.g., 'office visit', '99213', 'therapy')

functions.name: extract_medical_text
functions.description: Extract structured medical data from patient utterance: symptoms, vitals, severity, temporal info. Use when patient describes symptoms to get structured data for triage or coding.

patient_utterance.description: Patient's spoken description of symptoms, condition, or reason for visit (e.g., 'I have chest pain and shortness of breath for 2 days')

functions.name: assess_urgency
functions.description: Assess if patient symptoms indicate an emergency or urgent care need. Call when the patient describes symptoms before scheduling or coding. Returns EMERGENT (call 911), URGENT (same-day care), or ROUTINE.

symptoms_text.description: Patient's description of symptoms (e.g., 'chest pain radiating to arm, shortness of breath')

functions.name: suggest_codes_from_symptoms
functions.description: Get suggested ICD-10 and CPT codes from patient's description of symptoms or reason for visit. Use when patient describes their condition (e.g., 'I have diabetes and need a checkup', 'anxiety follow-up'). Returns top codes with patient-friendly descriptions and validated_pairs for compatible ICD-10+CPT combinations.

clinical_text.description: Patient's description of symptoms, reason for visit, or clinical note (e.g., 'type 2 diabetes follow-up', 'anxiety and depression')

functions.name: validate_code_pair
functions.description: Validate ICD-10 + CPT compatibility for billing. suggest_codes_from_symptoms returns pre-validated pairs; call this when combining codes from search_icd10_codes + search_cpt_codes.

functions.name: check_payer_guidelines
functions.description: Check if a payer has fee schedule/guidelines available for billing. Use when caller asks about insurance coverage for specific codes or before quoting prices.

payer_name.description: Payer name if payer_id not known

functions.name: get_code_pricing
functions.description: Get allowed amounts for CPT codes from payer fee schedule. Use when caller asks about cost, copay, or after suggesting codes when patient wants pricing info. Requires payer_id.

functions.name: search_hcpcs_codes
functions.description: Search HCPCS Level II codes (supplies, DME, drugs, modifiers). Use for procedures/supplies not in CPT (e.g., DME, injectable drugs, certain modifiers).

query.description: Search term - procedure, supply, modifier name or HCPCS code (e.g., 'wheelchair', 'E0601', 'modifier')

functions.name: schedule_demo
functions.description: Schedule a product demo for a clinic interested in Somo.

contact_name.description: Name of the person you spoke with

notes.description: Additional notes about the clinic or conversation

functions.name: collect_contact_info
functions.description: Collect contact information from a clinic for follow-up.

contact_name.description: Name of the person you spoke with

role.description: Their role (e.g., Office Manager, Practice Administrator)

interest_level.description: Level of interest: high, medium, low, or not_interested

functions.name: resolve_patient_plan
functions.description: Resolve spoken health plan name to canonical payor for SomoPay navigation.

plan_name.description: Health plan or insurer name spoken by member

functions.name: check_plan_benefits
functions.description: Return commercial benefit summaries for resolved plan near member ZIP.

functions.name: find_care_near_me
functions.description: Find bookable in-network providers for specialty near member ZIP.

functions.name: resolve_employer_member
functions.description: Resolve employer code + member id to plan without carrier name.

functions.name: end_call
functions.description: End the call when the customer is done or when the conversation is complete.
